mutations.name: repair rewrites tombstones
mutations.from: const tooLong = (row: T): boolean => row.deletedAt === null && bound(row) !== row;
mutations.to: const tooLong = (row: T): boolean => bound(row) !== row;
mutations.survives: Equivalent: a tombstone carries no text, so the repair has nothing to shorten in one; skipping them is for parity and to spend no write.
